jobs.occupation: Head of Risk (all genders welcome) (Leiter/in - Risikomanagement)
jobs.description:
Company

tk accelis Trading GmbH, formerly thyssenkrupp Materials Trading GmbH, is a dynamic trading and services company within the tk accelis Group. With approximately 300 employees worldwide, 14 locations across several continents, and annual revenue of over 2 billion euros, we serve more than 1,500 customers in the steel, raw materials, and manufacturing industries. Our portfolio includes over 350 products, which, in addition to steel products such as rolled steel and pipes, primarily consist raw materials such as alloys, non-ferrous metals, minerals, coke, coal, and ores. In addition to international trade, we offer customized solutions for the supply of modern technologies and equipment for the steel and raw materials industries. We focus on long-term, trust-based partnerships with suppliers and customers worldwide. Our expertise ranges from project development and financing solutions to global logistics—making us a reliable partner throughout the entire supply and value chain.

Your responsibilities

Together with your team, you will ensure the monitoring and effective management of price risks in international commodities trading

- Ensuring and further developing the calculation and reporting of relevant price risks in the international commodities business
- Managing derivative risk positions within defined risk mandates, in close coordination with the front office
- Compliance with relevant internal TK and external reporting requirements (including EMIR)
- Leading and developing a team of five FTEs; additionally, providing technical guidance to two decentralised risk controllers based abroad
- Acting as an active sparring partner for the trading division regarding hedging instruments, trading strategies, products and portfolio development
- Supporting and guiding the business in the implementation of new transactions and strategies, including coordination with TK AG’s central finance department as well as external brokers and banks
- Identifying and realising opportunities for improvement through the use of digital tools (Power BI, artificial intelligence, etc.)

Your profile

- A successfully completed degree in economics
- Expert in hedging and, consequently, international trading of commodity derivative positions on the London Metal Exchange (LME)
- Experienced in designing and implementing risk analyses and hedging strategies
- Commercial mindset, strong stakeholder focus, hands-on approach and results-oriented attitude
- Experience in effectively leading and developing teams
- Excellent communication and presentation skills, and the ability to explain complex topics clearly
- Entrepreneurial mindset
- A personable manner with good communication skills in German and English
- Empathy and a sense of humour

Don’t meet all the criteria in the job posting but still want to join tk accelis? We look forward to getting to know you!

Your benefits

- Flexible work schedules, remote work, and a variety of health promotion programs
- Excellent opportunities for personal and professional development within the team, the company, and the corporate group
- Attractive employee benefits, such as an outstanding company pension plan
- A modern workplace at the ruhrtechkampus in Essen, featuring a cafeteria, a café, ample parking, and good access to public transportation
- Additional corporate benefits, such as discounts on shopping, mobile phone plans, or sports activities

Have we piqued your interest? Then we look forward to receiving your online application in German or English via the “Apply Now” button!

Contact

Selina Elfert
Sourcing undamp; Recruiting
Tel: +49 173 606 1963

We value diversity

We value diversity and therefore welcome all applications, irrespective of gender, nationality, ethnic and social background, religion and beliefs, disability, age, or sexual orientation and identity.

Start Your Career at Telekom – Become Part of a Global Team!

 

Are you ready to conquer the world? Then you’ve come to the right place! Deutsche Telekom is represented in over 50 countries worldwide and is one of Europe’s leading telecommunications providers. Our products and services connect people and improve daily life. With the best network and a strong presence in the gigabit society, we set the standards. Our digital future is driven by more than 230,000 innovative minds. Become part of our team and shape your future with us.

 

 

Your Start Date – Completely Flexible:

 

Our trainee program starts at the beginning of every quarter – choose your preferred start date that suits you.

 

 

What Are You Waiting For?

 

Positions can be filled immediately. So, don’t wait too long – apply as soon as possible!

We look forward to receiving your application (CV & certificates) in English or German.

For more information about our trainee program, visit our career site (https://www.telekom.com/en/careers/students/trainee-program) .

 

Start your career with us and shape the digital future.

 

 

 

Additional Benefits:

 

- Guaranteed Target Position: Our trainees receive a permanent employment contract from the very beginning.
- Special Onboarding Program: You’ll receive a week of extensive onboarding, including networking, to ensure an optimal start to the program.
- Community as a Key Element: The trainee community is closely connected, with regular events to strengthen team cohesion.
- Strengthen Your Network: You design your program individually. We support you in this and help you with networking.
- Mentorship Program: The "Start up!" community offers a mentorship program with experienced executives who support you in your career development.
- Buddy Concept: Each trainee is supported by a buddy during onboarding who is available to answer questions.
- Strategic Thinking: In addition to your project assignments, there’s the opportunity to work on additional strategic projects.

 

 

Your Tasks

 

For talents with an entrepreneurial mindset and the courage to shape the future, the "Start up!" trainee program offers 18 months of space to learn and develop. We provide you with a wide range of insights into our organization and the opportunity to step out of your comfort zone and explore new topics to reach your full potential.

 

Additionally, We Offer You:

 

- Take Charge of Your Career! You will have five project assignments: the first within Technology & Innovation. After that, you can choose your subsequent projects individually – across the entire company.
- Step Out of Your Comfort Zone! After your first assignment, you decide which topics you want to dive deeper into. During the program, we want you to step out of your comfort zone and explore new fields within Deutsche Telekom. We will support you with a broad network.
- Expand Your Network and Experience the Trainee Community! Fridays are reserved for the “Magenta Friday". All trainees come together to work on strategic, innovative growth topics outside of their own project assignments. Trainees work in different teams where they organize events, foster their development, or contribute to social initiatives.
- Go International! A leading digital telecommunications company without international experience? Never! One of your (three-month) assignments will be abroad. You decide which country and city.
- Understand Our Business! Take the opportunity to get to know Deutsche Telekom’s operational business. During our "Service Days," you can gain direct insights into how Deutsche Telekom works with customers. Choose your "Service Days", such as a day in customer service, a visit to a T-Shop, or a stop at one of our service centers. You’ll gain direct insights into how we turn customers into fans every day.
- Choose Your Start Date! Every quarter, there is the opportunity to start the program. Simply discuss with your contact person which date suits you best.

 

 

 

Your Profile

 

You have successfully completed a degree in economics, business administration, IT, Sales, Marketing or a comparable field of study – all degree levels (bachelor's, master's, doctorate) are welcome. You possess strong customer and service orientation.

You bring the following skills and qualifications:

- Service Orientation: You have a pronounced service mindset and strive to meet our customers' needs in the best possible way.
- Relevant Experience: You have accumulated at least 6 months of relevant internships or work experience in areas such as service, business clients, private clients, or data-related environments.
- Project Management, Consultancy: You have knowledge and initial experience in project management and/or management consultancy and are capable of effectively planning, coordinating, and successfully completing projects.
- Trends: You follow current trends and developments in the industry and bring fresh ideas and approaches to our projects and products.
- Sales and Marketing Experience: You have practical experience in sales and/or marketing. This enables you to understand customer needs, craft effective marketing strategies, and contribute to the development and execution of successful sales initiatives.
- Intercultural Competence: Our Start up! community thrives on its international diversity. Therefore, strong intercultural skills should be part of your DNA. International experience – whether through studying abroad, work & travel, etc. – is therefore a must.
- Social Engagement: As a Start up! trainee, you are passionate about driving change! Experience in social engagement and/or entrepreneurial projects is highly welcomed.
- Language Skills: You are fluent in English (C1 level) and are willing to learn German independently.

Severely disabled applicants with equal qualification will be given particular consideration.

 

Your contact: Nadine Rohland 
Phone: +49 151 28438708 
E-mail: nadine.rohland@telekom.de 

 

https://www.xing.com/companies/deutschetelekomag (https://www.xing.com/companies/deutschetelekomag)
https://www.linkedin.com/company/telekom (https://www.linkedin.com/company/telekom)

Your Work Shapes the World at Caterpillar Inc.

When you join Caterpillar, you're joining a global team who cares not just about the work we do – but also about each other. We are the makers, problem solvers, and future world builders who are creating stronger, more sustainable communities. We don't just talk about progress and innovation here – we make it happen, with our customers, where we work and live. Together, we are building a better world, so we can all enjoy living in it.

Category Buyer - Indirect Purchasing

At Caterpillar, we’re committed to our customers, who build a better, more sustainable world with our products, services and solutions. We understand and show the value of why they should choose us. We’re exploring new ideas and opportunities – innovating to discover the breakthroughs necessary for tomorrow’s growth. Through it all, we are one team (https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=mYIDne7Q5ek&list=PLwAXbfivFg0jmiNqqgFLeQJpRB_i-UVln&index=39)  – creating and delivering world-class products, services and solutions superior to the competition. Learn more about the Caterpillar Experience (https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=GvCYWtWARlk&list=PLwAXbfivFg0jmiNqqgFLeQJpRB_i-UVln&index=25) .

Caterpillar Inc. is the world’s leading manufacturer of construction and mining equipment, off-highway diesel and natural gas engines, industrial gas turbines and diesel-electric locomotives. We have an exciting opportunity for a Category Buyer - Indirect Purchasing to join our Large Power Systems team, supporting Caterpillar’s large engine production at the Kiel facility. In this role, you will leverage QCLDM (Quality, Cost, Logistics, Development, and Management) principles to deliver value across the supply network. You will develop and execute category strategies, manage supplier relationships, and drive cost, quality, and service improvements across indirect spending. Acting as a key interface between stakeholders and suppliers, you will ensure alignment with business needs, support sourcing decisions, and monitor supplier performance to build strong, long-term partnerships.

Monthly salary from €6,035+, depending on experience.

What You Will Do:

- Lead strategic and operational procurement of indirect goods and services (e.g., IT, engineering, facilities, HR)
- Drive end-to-end sourcing activities, including supplier evaluation and selection
- Negotiate with domestic and international suppliers to secure optimal terms
- Identify and deliver cost-saving initiatives and continuous improvement opportunities
- Build and manage strong supplier relationships and performance
- Partner with internal stakeholders to define requirements and support business needs
- Ensure compliance with policies and standards while supporting contracts, CAPEX activities, and sourcing strategy execution

What You Have:

- Several years of experience in procurement, ideally within indirect purchasing
- Fluency in English and German (C1 level)
- Strong analytical and data interpretation skills to support decision-making
- Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, enabling effective stakeholder collaboration
- Proven negotiation skills with experience working with internal and external partners
- Solid understanding of procurement processes, including strategic sourcing and contract management
- Experience in supplier relationship management and driving performance
- Creative, solution-oriented mindset
- Good knowledge of MS Office and SAP, with a willingness to learn new technologies

What Will Put You Ahead (Preferred Skills):

- Technical degree combined with extensive experience in the field
- Experience in an international, matrix organization

What You Will Get:

- Varied, responsible, and challenging tasks
- Excellent earning opportunities according to the Caterpillar compensation system
- 30 days of vacation
- Company pension plan
- Bicycle leasing / job ticket

Additional Information:

We are back! This role requires being in the office five days a week.

A valid work permit or EU-25/EFTA citizenship is required for this position

About Caterpillar

Caterpillar Inc. is the world’s leading manufacturer of construction and mining equipment, off-highway diesel and natural gas engines, industrial gas turbines and diesel-electric locomotives. For the past 100 years, we’ve been helping customers build a better, more sustainable world and are committed and contributing to a reduced-carbon future. Our innovative products and services, backed by our global dealer network, provide exceptional value that helps customers succeed.

We value authenticity and encourage candidates to submit original, personally crafted responses throughout our hiring process. Use of AI-generated content may disadvantage your application.

Site Manager / Superintendent Mechanical Engineering / Plant Construction (m/f/d) in Olfen

Since the company was founded in 1989, OLKO-Maschinentechnik GmbH has been one of the driving forces in the shaft sinking and hoisting technology segment. As a 100% subsidiary of the THYSSEN SCHACHTBAU Group, we are at home in the relevant international markets and supply innovations from the cradle of mining all over the world.

What sets us apart is that we don't do things by halves: OLKO-Maschinentechnik GmbH stands for pioneering system solutions with a high degree of vertical integration and components developed and often patented in-house.

For our locations in 59399 Olfen and worldwide, we are looking as soon as possible to recruit a qualified

Site Manager / Superintendent Mechanical Engineering / Plant Construction (m/f/d)

Your tasks:

• Independent construction management of assembly projects

• Technical and organizational responsibility on the construction site

• Supporting the project manager directly on site at the customer's premises

• Work preparation and coordination of subcontractors

• Creation of assembly documentation

• Conducting construction meetings, instructions, customer inspections and customer acceptance tests

• Helping to achieve the project goals in terms of deadlines, quality and costs

Our requirements:

• Experience as site manager/supervisor or

• Experience as a foreman with the desire to develop into a site manager in the future

• Completed technical training in the field of mechanical engineering

• Willingness to travel internationally

• Team player with high motivation, problem-solving skills, strong leadership and commitment

• Sound knowledge of hydraulics

• Good knowledge of English

• Sense of responsibility

• MS-Office knowledge

We offer:

• Responsible, challenging and varied work in an international company

• Secure job with room for further development

• Flexible working hours

• Option for job bike

• Employee parking spaces

• Company events and sports activities

• Attractive overall package of benefits and social services (e. g. laptop, cell phone)

Please send your application with all the necessary documents, stating your salary expectations and possible starting date, exclusively online to our applicant portal.

The University Hospital Bonn (UKB) is one of Germany’s leading university hospitals, combining top-level performance in medicine and research with excellence in teaching. Each year, more than half a million patients receive inpatient and outpatient care at the UKB. Around 3,500 students study medicine and dentistry here, and over 600 people are trained annually in healthcare professions. With approximately 9,900 employees, the UKB is the third-largest employer in the Bonn/Rhein-Sieg region. In the Focus hospital ranking, the UKB ranks first among university hospitals in North Rhine-Westphalia and second nationwide in terms of case mix index (case severity). In 2024, the UKB raised nearly €100 million in third-party funding for research, development, and teaching. The F.A.Z. Institute has named the UKB “Germany’s Training Champion” and “Germany’s Most Attractive Employer” for the fourth consecutive year.

The following full-time **(38.5 hours/week) position is to be filled as soon as possible in the Division for Computational Radiology & Clinical AI (CCIBonn.ai)** of the University Hospital Bonn:

Software Engineer/Developer (m/f/d)

The position is limited to 2 years.

We, at the division for Computational Radiology & Clinical AI (CCIBonn.ai) at the University Hospital Bonn / University of Bonn (PI: Philipp Vollmuth – Full Professor of AI in Medical Imaging), are seeking applications for Software Engineer positions to support our software platform team. Our research group has consistently contributed to leading journals and conferences, and we are developing a range of tools to support our research projects. You can check out our work on our GitHub organizations (OpenRadX (https://github.com/openradx)  and CCIBonn (https://github.com/CCI-Bonn) ). This opportunity offers a unique chance to work at the forefront of medical AI and contribute to substantial advancement in the medical field. You will be part of a dynamic team that bridges the gap between cutting-edge AI research and clinical application, ensuring that our software tools are robust, efficient, and user-friendly.

Tasks:

- Develop, test, and maintain software applications for computational radiology and medical AI
- Program backend and frontend code for tools like ADIT (Automated DICOM Transfer Tool) (https://github.com/openradx/adit)  and RADIS (Radiology Report Archive and Discovery System) (https://github.com/openradx/radis)
- Work closely with researchers and clinicians to implement and enhance application features
- Write technical documentation

Requirements:

- A master’s degree in computer science, software engineering, or a related field.
- Documented contributions to open-source projects (own repositories or significant contributions to established projects) are required. Please provide links to relevant GitHub or GitLab profiles in your application
- Proficiency in web programming and expertise in programming languages such as Python, TypeScript, and/or Rust
- Experience with tools and frameworks such as Django, pytest, PostgreSQL, Docker, and PyTorch is advantageous
- Knowledge of medical imaging data, DICOM standards, NLP, full-text search, semantic search, RAG, fine-tuning of deep learning models, and agentic engineering is considered a plus
- Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to work collaboratively within a multidisciplinary team
- German language proficiency at B2 level or higher is mandatory. Applicants must be able to communicate fluently in spoken and written German in a clinical and technical environment. Applications without demonstrated B2-level proficiency in German will not be considered
- Excellent communication skills in English, both written and verbal

**We offer:** 

- Competitive 2 years 100% contract within TV-L E-13 standard, with the possibility for extension.
- Exclusive access to the latest and powerful computing resources (NVIDIA DGX H200 and B200 clusters).
- Collaborate with a dynamic and multidisciplinary team bridging AI research and clinical application.
- Opportunities to attend national and international conferences (e.g. MICCAI, CVPR)
- **Responsible and diverse:** A position with plenty of room for creativity and responsibility within a supportive and collegial team
- **Fair compensation:** Pay according to the TV-L EG13 collective agreement, including annual bonus and company pension scheme
- **Family-friendly flexibility:** Flexible working time models, access to a place in our company daycare center, and programs supporting employees returning from parental leave
- **Smart commuting:** Excellent connection to the SWB public transport
- **Supported development:** Individual training opportunities through courses, e-learning programs, and coaching sessions
- **Structured onboarding:** A systematic introduction to your new role and team
- **Healthy at work:** A wide range of health and wellness programs, plus free membership at the UKB fitness studio
- **Employee benefits:** Access to discounted offers for employees (corporate benefits)

We are committed to diversity and equal opportunities. Our goal is to increase the proportion of women in areas where women are underrepresented and to particularly promote their careers. We therefore urge relevantly qualified women to apply. Applications are treated in accordance with the State Equal Opportunities Act. Applications from suitable people with proven severe disabilities and those of equal status are particularly welcome.

How to apply:

If you meet the above requirements, please send your complete application documents to contact@ccibonn.ai (https://mailto:contact@ccibonn.ai) , including:

- ST-number 48006
- CV
- Academic transcripts (including final grades)
- Proof of German proficiency at B2 level or higher (unless native speaker)
- GitHub or GitLab profile link
- A short description (max. 1 page) of one software system personally designed and implemented, including technologies used and specific responsibilities

Only applications including all required materials will be considered.

Division for Computational Radiology & Clinical AI

University Hospital Bonn

Baunscheidtstraße 17

53113 Bonn

Collins Aerospace is a leader in technologically advanced, intelligent solutions that help redefine the aerospace and defense industry. With a comprehensive portfolio and deep technical expertise, we help customers meet the demands of the global market. Join us and help shape the future of aerospace and defense.

We are looking for a Quality Engineer (m/f/d) to strengthen our team and play a key role in ensuring and continuously improving product quality throughout our value stream.

You are analytical, data-driven, and passionate about solving complex challenges. At the same time, you enjoy taking ownership, driving improvements, and influencing outcomes across the organization. If you thrive in a dynamic manufacturing environment where quality, performance, and continuous improvement go hand in hand, we would like to meet you.

Location: Lübeck, on-site

Your Responsibilities

- Analyze, evaluate, and visualize quality performance indicators (e.g., First Pass Yield, SRR, Customer PPM) and drive measurable improvements in cooperation operative Quality Engineers
- Support development projects with a focus on error prevention and process robustness using APQP toolset
- Own and manage the non-conformance management process, ensuring timely resolution and sustainable corrective actions
- Coordinate and facilitate the resolution of production-related quality issues
- Lead the handling of customer concerns and complaints, including root cause analysis and implementation of preventive measures
- Act as a trusted advisor to production teams on all quality-related matters
- Support cross-functional projects within the designated value stream organization
- Serve as a key interface between Production, Purchasing, Engineering, and other internal stakeholders
- Contribute to the strategic development and optimization of inspection and quality assurance processes
- Lead and coordinate continuous improvement initiatives
- Implement and maintain company-specific quality processes and standards
- Support the Quality Manager in the regular evaluation and continuous improvement of the management system

What You Bring

- Degree in Engineering, Applied Sciences, or a comparable technical qualification (e.g., Master Technician)
- Professional experience and training in Quality Management and quality-related methodologies mandatory including APQP
- Experience in KPI management and improvement projects
- Experience in project management / coordination
- Strong analytical skills and a structured, data-driven approach to problem-solving
- Ability to take ownership, influence stakeholders, and drive change effectively
- Excellent communication and collaboration skills across different organizational levels
- Fluent German and English language skills are essential (C1+)
- Proficient in Microsoft Office applications

What You Will Gain

- Collaboration with some of the world's most prestigious global customers
- The opportunity to make a visible impact on product quality and operational performance
- A challenging role with a high degree of responsibility and autonomy
- Professional growth through cross-functional projects and continuous development opportunities

Your Benefits

Enjoy a range of attractive benefits, including 30 days of annual leave to support a healthy work-life balance, a childcare allowance to help you balance family and professional commitments, and access to our Cycle to Work scheme for sustainable and flexible commuting. We also offer a company pension scheme and capital-forming benefits to support your long-term financial wellbeing.

More flexibility, greater security, and valuable benefits for both your professional and personal life. Apply today!

Joining Collins Aerospace isn’t just about finding a job; it’s about embarking on a journey to redefine the future of aerospace technology. 

Collins Aerospace, an RTX company, is a leader in technologically advanced and intelligent solutions for the global aerospace and defence industry. Collins Aerospace has the capabilities, comprehensive portfolio, and expertise to solve customers’ toughest challenges and to meet the demands of a rapidly evolving global market.  

This an opportunity for an Indirect Buyer to join the ever-successful Lubeck Collins site. You will ensure continuous flow of indirect Goods and Services in support of manufacturing, facilities, engineering, and all other functional areas of the business for Military and Civil requirements.

Join Our Team!

What you will do 

- Manage incoming Material Requisitions from the site in line with Indirect Procurement Service Levels
- Purchase Goods, Services and MRO items for indirect/non-product procurement
- Creation and management of Blanket Purchase Orders
- Align supplier schedules with production schedules / internal customer requirements
- Evaluate supplier quotes and services to determine most desirable source of supply and create
- Monitor supplier delivery, On Time In Full (OTIF) and quality performance where required
- Manage Non-Conformance Reports (NCR’s)
- Participate in negotiations of long-term agreements with suppliers
- Be able to identify business and legal risks associated with Indirect Purchases of Goods and Services
- Negotiate with the supply base for reduced pricing and payment terms improvements
- Create and present metrics and support reports to suppliers, peers, and managers
- Develop and maintain key supplier relationships to include on-site audits, program/performance

What you will learn 

- To adapt and improve your agility in an ever-changing landscape
- Industry specific knowledge
- To excel in a highly innovative environment

Experience & Skills 

- Proven experience working in a Tactical Buyer position
- Demonstratable experience and understanding in an Indirect Buying role
- Must have strong organizational and time management skills to handle multiple projects simultaneously
- Adhere to all UTC rules and codes of conduct
- Ensure Compliance with all Corporate Polices
- Understanding of PO Contract Packages per Compliance standards
- Experience working with MRP system
- Excellent communication skills and the willingness to collaborate with internal and external teams
- Fluent in German and English (C1 or above) is essential
- Please note this is a 2 year fixed term contract

Certifications 

- Bachelor's and Degree in Business, Supply Chain Management, Finance, English, Accounting, Business/Administration, Engineering, Education, Communication, Management or equivalent experience

What we Offer you 

- An international company with a lot of expertise in aviation
- Global talent management program
- A unique and dedicated team
- Flexible working hours
- Individual training opportunities
- Attractive salary
- Great team events
- Company health care
- Company pension plan
- Job bike
- Company sports program
- Canteen with fresh kitchen

The Opportunity 

You will be part of a highly flexible development team for the MeTS Hardware Security Modules with members in Brussels, Aachen and abroad, so good communication skills are essential. The Software Architect and Project Manager for the MeTS HSM is responsible for designing the embedded application software of the Hardware Security Module (HSM). This role requires expertise in embedded programming, a strong background in C and experience with applied cryptography and cryptographic primitives.  
This role is as another aspect also responsible for the close management and coordination of an offshore development team from our German office, ensuring the quality, consistency and timely delivery of the system software for the Hardware Security Module (HSM). This requires hands-on technical involvement — including systematic source code reviews, creation and validation of cryptographic test vectors, and architectural guidance — combined with strong project management discipline. 

Day-to-Day Responsibilities 

Managing and steering an offshore development team to deliver security products in embedded systems for financial transactions, smart grid, eHealth and others. Overseeing the definition, analysis, development and validation of security-related applications on a Hardware Security Module, with direct technical involvement in code quality, testing and architecture. Help developing the architecture of security products in embedded systems for financial transactions, smart grid, eHealth and others. Defining, analyzing, developing and validating security-related applications on a Hardware Security Module.

Key Responsibilities:

- System Design: Develop and maintain the architecture for the system software of the MeTS HSMs ADYTON and ASM.
- Technical and Project Leadership: Guide and support in-house and offshore development teams in best practices for implementing the HSM software.  
- Agile Development: Collaborate with cross-functional teams in an agile environment, participating in sprint planning, reviews, and retrospectives. 
- Stakeholder Collaboration: Work closely with the Product Owner and Product Manager to gather requirements, prioritize features, and translate them into technical specifications. 
- Documentation: Create and maintain comprehensive documentation of interface designs, and security measures specific to the MeTS HSMs. 
- Quality Assurance: Ensure that software solutions adhere to industry standards for security and performance. 
- Problem Solving: Identify and resolve technical challenges related to MeTS HSM integration. 
- You are a technical leader able to lead and guide off-shore and in-house teams in architecture, analysis and developments for made-to-measure customer solutions.
- You have a strong background in C, it would be apricated if you have a good knowledge in C++ and Java. The team work in an agile environment with a high demand of independent, autonomously and pro-active way to structure tasks and solve issues.
- The ideal candidate should possess proficiency in C programming and embedded systems development, along with a strong understanding of cryptography.
- Experience with secure coding practices and security standards is essential.
- Excellent communication and interpersonal skills are also required to effectively collaborate with team members and stakeholders. 

These qualities are essential! We’re also looking for the following skills and experience:

- Specialist in computer science with a related university degree 
- Proven experience managing offshore or distributed development teams with close technical oversight 
- Strong aptitude for analysis, a results-oriented worker capable of finding creative solutions 
- Excellent team player with the ability to build trust and maintain productivity across cultural and geographical boundaries 
- Outstanding communication skills, and a good command of spoken and written English 
- Awareness of a range of development support tools 
- Quick adaptation to new technologies 

Who Are We Looking For 

We look for big thinkers. People who can drive positive change, step up and show what’s next – people with passion, can-do attitude and a hunger to learn and grow. In practice this means: 

- Experience with embedded systems and C development 
- Proven ability to conduct meaningful source code reviews in C, identifying defects, security vulnerabilities and optimization opportunities 
- Experience creating and validating cryptographic test vectors for algorithm verification and compliance testing 
- Strong architectural knowledge of embedded systems and Hardware Security Modules 
- Knowledge of testing methodology (unit, integration, white/black box testing …) 
- Good knowledge of security standards like PCI PIN, PCI PTS HSM, ANSI X9.143 (TR31), ASC X9 TR34, EMVCo and similar
- Solid background in security (hardware and/or software), cryptographic algorithms and primitives and applied cryptography 
- Knowledge of OpenSSL and ASN.1 is a plus  
- German language proficiency is a plus 
- PMP, PRINCE2 or equivalent project management certification is a plus 

Benefits 

- Flextime & mobile working 
- Company pension plan 
- Individual training programs 
- Job bike & diverse range of employee discounts 
- Mobility and food subsidies 
- Good public transport connections and free parking (location-specific) 
- Regular employee events 
- Sustainable, international company culture

Global Commodity Manager Valves & Actuators

As a Corporate Commodity Manager for Valves & Actuators, you will be part of Corporate Strategic Procurement team (SE P DM SYS RA), lead a cross-functional team globally and are responsible for a Corporate commodity strategy. Postdocs (2 years) (m,f,x)

The Cluster of Excellence "CASA: Securing the Digital Society" is funded by DFG for the years 2026-2032 with approximately 53 million euros. CASA aims to strengthen the resilience of our digital society. The emergence of disruptive technologies in recent years, especially artificial intelligence and quantum computers, has caused substantial new challenges for cybersecurity research. In the second funding phase, CASA will specifically address these challenges. Thematic priorities include the security of quantum technologies, protection against Al-based disinformation and societal polarization, and new approaches to defending against ransomware. In addition to technical questions, it also investigates the interaction of human behavior and cybersecurity. Research at CASA, which is based at the Horst Görtz Institute for IT Security, follows a strongly interdisciplinary approach. Researchers from the fields of computer science, cryptography, electrical engineering, mathematics, and psychology work together in a unique constellation in Europe. This holistic approach is unparalleled and holds the potential for scientific breakthroughs. Ruhr-University Bochum (RUB) and its Faculty of Computer Science offer an excellent environment for aspiring young researchers. Some 20 years ago, the Horst Görtz Institute for IT Security (HGI) was founded here. lt is now one of Europe's most prestigious institutions for basic computer security research. The HGI maintains extensive networks with leading research institutions worldwide and with media and industry. Moreover, it has produced numerous successful security startups. The pioneering work of the HGI forms the basis for the Cluster of Excellence CASA.

Scope: full-time
Duration: fixed-term, 2 years
Start: at the earliest possible date
Apply by:  2026-09-14

- Our goal is to attract postdoctoral researchers and enable them to conduct their research with the mentorship of a PI. - We offer two-year positions for postdoctoral candidates.

- Fluent spoken and written English is also required.
